prayerExcerpt.en-US: I resolved to know nothing while I was with you except Jesus Christ, and him crucified.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Não julguei saber coisa alguma entre vós, a não ser Jesus Cristo, e este, crucificado.

meta.face: A man of about sixty with a large, broad, oblong face and a high forehead over a jutting brow ridge; a strong Roman nose with a pronounced hump at the bridge; deep-set eyes under heavy dark brows; broad cheekbones; a strong, deep jaw; a wide mouth with a full lower lip; thick, wavy salt-and-pepper hair brushed back from the forehead to the nape, a full, broad, square-cut beard, dark streaked with grey, and a searching, thoughtful gaze.
meta.basis: Dionysius gives Justin the Philosopher as an old man with a large beard; the Stavronikita icon by Theophanes the Cretan shows him in a philosopher's cloak with a full dark beard. The grey-streaked dark beard sits between the two, and the cloak follows his own account of being recognised as a philosopher by his dress.
